# VibeCode Mentor: AI Project Blueprint Generator

> VibeCode Mentor is the premier platform for "vibecoding"—the future of software development where you guide AI to build your vision. Generate production-ready architectural blueprints, detailed technical specifications, and 30-minute implementation roadmaps using Mistral AI. Built with Next.js 15, .NET 9, Docker, and PostgreSQL for enterprise-grade reliability.

## Core Features

### Blueprint Generation Engine
Instantly create comprehensive project blueprints including architecture diagrams, database schemas, API specifications, and deployment strategies. Our Mistral AI integration analyzes your project requirements and delivers production-ready plans in seconds.

### AI Chat Assistant
Ask questions, refine project requirements, and get expert guidance from a 24/7 AI mentor. The chat assistant helps you explore architectural options, resolve technical bottlenecks, and optimize your technology choices.

### 30-Minute Project Planning
Each blueprint includes a structured 30-minute implementation roadmap that breaks down your entire project into actionable steps, dependencies, and milestones—perfect for solo founders and agile teams.

### Template Library
Access 10+ vetted templates for common project types: SaaS applications, e-commerce platforms, mobile app backends, AI tools, full-stack applications, and more. Every template includes best-practice architecture.

### Export & Integration
Export blueprints as PDF, Markdown, or JSON. Push directly to GitHub repositories. Sync blueprints across devices with real-time cloud synchronization powered by Supabase.

**Blueprint Logic:** Our generation algorithm combines domain knowledge in software architecture, modern tech stacks (Next.js, React, Vue, Django, .NET), cloud deployment patterns, and agile development practices.

**Transparency:** Every generated blueprint includes source explanations for architectural decisions, recommended technology choices, and trade-off analyses.
